intent_preservation_rule: Evaluate against preserved raw/human-approved intent and explicit constraints: no loss of goal, no added goals, no silent priority change. Do not use semantic similarity or model interpretation as authority.
required_before_run: authorized runner with outbound HTTPS to the provider API
GEMINI_API_KEY configured in runner secret environment, never chat/repo/evidence
candidate model IDs verified against official provider documentation immediately before execution
selection_rule: Do not select a production worker from reputation or prior calibration alone. Compare the same immutable cases and evaluate correctness, scope compliance, authority violations, goal expansion, intent preservation, structured-output validity, rationale quality, evidence plan, tokens, cost, latency, retries and human corrections. Selection remains pending human evaluation after the reproducible API benchmark.

provider_swap_test.purpose: Test whether Saddle preserves the Phase 4B benchmark/effect boundaries when the Intelligence provider changes without changing the protocol, immutable cases, authority model or evaluator.
